verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a payments platform, but the evidence pack never documents a bulk export of account, transaction, or customer data in open formats, or an account-exit path. The pack covers moving funds out (payouts, offramp, fiat rails), webhooks, and API and CLI access. These are fund transfers or developer building blocks, not a first-party data-export capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
